color.name: --gradient-background
color.raw:
radial-gradient(
      120% 90% at 0% 0%,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--red-500) 12%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    radial-gradient(100% 80% at 100% 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--blue-300) 40%, transparent) 0%, transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--off-white) 0%, var(--off-white) 100%)

other.name: --gradient-surface-subtle
other.raw:
linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--red-500) 5%, var(--white)) 0%,
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--blue-300) 14%, var(--white)) 100%
  )
